item.title: [Due in 6 days] Azure Blueprints stops accepting new assignments on 31 October, and its resource locks stop working at full retirement
item.description:
Blueprint assignments can apply Do Not Delete and Read Only locks. Those locks stop functioning at retirement, so any resource whose protection rests on a blueprint lock silently loses it — and the definitions that describe what was being protected are deleted at the same time.

Azure · deadline 2026-10-31 · Export every blueprint definition, version and assignment you intend to keep before 31 January 2027, and before 31 October decide the replacement for each lock: Azure Policy deny or denyAction for the rule, and a resource lock for the deletion protection.

item.description:

From November the ring is frozen as it stands; from January the only early ring is Frontier, and Deferred release becomes the first option that holds a major update back by about 30 days.

item.description:

The cost falls on teams that distribute line-of-business app packages by mail, which will fail without an error anyone anticipated, and the change reaches custom policies too, not only the default one.

Exchange Online · deadline 2026-11-01 · Search mail flow for .msix and .msixbundle attachments over the last 90 days; if a business process depends on them, move it off email rather than adding the types to AllowedFileTypes, and record the decision before early November.
